decisions: Petrol and diesel regionalization uses native complete allocated refinery outputs, not storage/blend/combustion inventories. Shared regional proxy selection and relinking remain unchanged.
Wood ethanol uses the native 95% dry-basis reference, matching the original shared ethanol-production boundary and 26.5 MJ per kg dry ethanol. No concentration multiplier or added dehydration stage.

Swedish wood ethanol and CH/RER petrol are screening geographic, technology and vintage proxies outside source coverage; no LCIA equivalence is claimed. Native inventories, signs and uncertainty stay under the normal shared transformation.
